note: Commonwealth Bank's Everyday Account Smart Access: a monthly account fee of 4 dollars, waived for a holder under 30, in a month at least 2,000 dollars is deposited (bank-initiated transactions excluded), or in a month the holder qualifies for CommBank Yello Plus, Gold or Diamond (not modelled). Read again 2026-10-30: an overdraw fee of $15 when payments go through past the available funds (at most one a day, which the form doesn't hold) and 14.90% a year for each day overdrawn; a cheque or direct debit dishonoured for want of funds $5.00; a debit card purchase in another currency 3.5%; a withdrawal overseas at any other bank AUD$5.00 plus 3.5% ($2.00 at ASB in New Zealand and CommBank machines abroad); CommBank charges nothing at another bank's ATM in Australia (the owner's own fee, shown at the machine, isn't the bank's). Not stated on this page: interest on the account, its own ATMs, transfers, what opening asks, a savings account.
